## Where we are

We finished the listening sessions on Tuesday. Twelve people, four departments, one shared complaint: nobody trusts the holdings count.

## What we found

- The ILS and the digital repository disagree on 1,840 records.
- Most conflicts are date fields, not titles.
- The spreadsheet in Special Collections is the only source for 212 items.

## Next week

We trace each conflict to the system that last wrote it, then build the first prototype view. Expect a working link on Friday.
